scope: Diagnostic comparison of public preview APIs on the main thread and in a persistent Node worker_threads worker using structured clone or transferable coordinate buffers. Transfer mode clones record metadata and rehydrates coordinates on the main thread in consumeInBatches with a 4ms target. Total completion minus worker execution is combined clone, delivery, main-thread reconstruction, and scheduling; it is not clone-only attribution. Maximum 1ms timer gap is a responsiveness observation, not application CPU duration. Not a browser, rendering, GPU, or production-default comparison.
